scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev:client: cd client && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:server: cd server && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../client && npm run typecheck
